scope: Independent offline visible-text/layout inspection of exactly eight existing D906 PNGs for the first figure-free approved text excerpts only.

usage.visualOpenDefinition: One functions.view_image call per exact D906 screenshot path. Raw byte hashing and IHDR header reads did not decode or visually open images.
usage.inspectionMethod: One multi_tool_use.parallel batch containing exactly eight functions.view_image calls; no reopens, crops, resizes, resets, or additional image calls.

limitations: Inspected tool-provided previews only. Their display scale is not measured or guaranteed to be 1:1; long captures may be fitted or downscaled by the preview pipeline.
Paragraph-level text correspondence and visible layout were readable. Fine strokes, antialiasing, punctuation details, and every glyph at native resolution are not certified.
No crop, zoom, resize, reopening, OCR, new screenshot, or rerender was used to extend the evidence.
Six PNGs are taller than their nominal capture viewports. Their complete vertical framing is reviewed as full-page captures, not proof that all text fits in one viewport or that live scrolling works.
The inspected surface is the existing figure-free excerpt rendering, not a live application, interactive app shell, full lesson, or complete-course acceptance check.
Chinese and English are each compared to their own frozen approved strings in matched entry order; no scientific or translation-semantic re-review is performed.
All figures, captions, unselected prose, source.data, source pages, paid holds, SCI/source approvals, and formal promotion remain outside this review.

summary.visibleTextCorrespondence: The selected paragraph groups appear in frozen order in each locale and viewport, without an observed missing or substituted paragraph.
summary.definitionAndMotionConditionText: All frozen definition/medium blocks and all four nonempty entry-7 lines are visibly present in the wave-medium-and-motion records.
summary.energyVacuumParagraphCompleteness: Every entry-20 and entry-21 paragraph group, including their concluding lines, is visibly present in the four wave-speed-energy-and-vacuum records.
summary.typographyAndWrapping: Consistent readable heading/body hierarchy, flush-left paragraphs, separated blocks, and readable Chinese/English wrapping; no observed tofu or visibly corrupt text at preview scale.
summary.clippingOverlapAndEmptyStates: No observed lateral or bottom text clipping, collisions with headings or rules, overlapping paragraphs, blank substitute content, or error-only state.
summary.viewportFraming: Desktop captures retain a centered reading column with clear margins; mobile captures use a narrow full-width reading column with side padding. All selected endings remain inside their respective PNG frames.
summary.bilingualReviewBoundary: Matched selected entry order and visible presence only; different line-wrap and paragraph totals are retained from each locale's approved text, not forced into equivalence.
